name: Prismatic Bejeweled Unihornfish
description: A valuable Ornamental Fish that may be kept in the Pool of Sapphire Grace and Shaded Clarity.\nA peculiar fish species with a single horn. Sturdy and round, it boasts a bouncy belly akin to a balloon.\nA member of the Bejeweled Unihornfish family. Due to a shipping accident in years past, it was stranded in a specific body of water and altered by surrounding pollutants. The crystalline horn atop its head has taken on the hue of solid Phlogiston, though its origin is entirely different from its relative, the "Phony Phlogiston Unihornfish." After a period of rehabilitation in an aquarium, the harmful substances have been completely purged from its body. While the creature is now out of danger, its unique physical traits persist to this day...
